name: Auto Structure Read
summary: Type a symbol. Claude rebuilds the Auto Market Structure & Liquidity readings on 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W: Dow structure with BOS and CHoCH, the Protected level, the Fibonacci leg, the Bottom-out areas, liquidity sweeps and the v5 volume layers, then explains the structure by principle in a chat summary and an HTML report with a structure map.
stateOnly: It describes state only. No buy or sell calls, entries, stops or targets. You make every decision.
language: English edition: the skill writes its reports in English.

features.title: Structure on four timeframes
features.text: Uptrend or Downtrend per timeframe with BOS and CHoCH, the Protected level and its distance in ATR, and how the timeframes line up.

features.title: Structure map
features.text: The last 120 closed bars of the chart timeframe with swings, the Protected level, liquidity zones, Bottom-out areas and the volume layers on one chart.

features.title: Position in the leg
features.text: Where the close sits in the current leg: the share recovered, the Bottom-out Stable and Confirm areas, and what a close above each one means.

features.title: Liquidity and sweeps
features.text: Equal highs and lows, the zones price is drawn to, and the sweeps that already happened.

features.title: Volume layers (v5)
features.text: Order blocks with the volume traded inside them, the leg volume profile with POC and 70% value area, and Smart POC levels, when the bars carry volume.

features.title: What changes the structure
features.text: Prices where a close turns the structure (CHoCH), continues it (BOS) or completes a Bottom-out. They describe state, not trade levels.

requirements: Claude on any plan with Skills (web, desktop or mobile), or Claude Code
Code execution turned on in Claude
One price-data route: the TradingView connector or CSV files
noNeed: No API keys and no Python packages. The scripts use the Python standard library only and download nothing while they run.

installApp.title: Claude (web / desktop)
steps: Download autostruct-read-en.zip from this page. Keep it zipped.
In Claude, open Settings → Capabilities and turn on Code execution and file creation (newer layouts: Create and edit files).
Go to Customize → Skills, click + → Create skill → Upload a skill, and choose the zip.
Make sure the skill is switched on. For the easiest data route, also add the TradingView connector.
installApp.note: Team or Enterprise: an owner must allow Skills and Code execution first.

installCode.title: Claude Code
steps: Copy the folder so the file sits at the path below.
Start Claude Code and type a command, for example autostruct-read-en XAUUSD.

update: To update: remove the old skill, then upload the new zip (or replace the folder in Claude Code).
firstRun: Type autostruct-read-en and a symbol. Add the exchange when the name is ambiguous, for example OANDA:XAUUSD.
The report opens with a QUICK MODE box that shows the settings used: swing size 2.0 × ATR(14) and Style Auto. Check that they match your Auto Structure inputs.
If they differ, say so (for example swing 2.5, or Style Swing) and the skill runs again.
defaults: Defaults: chart timeframe 1D, 300 bars per timeframe, swing size 2.0 × ATR(14), Style Auto. Every reading uses the last closed bar, like the indicator; a forming bar is shown as a Live line, not a reading.

commands.what: Chart TF 1D, swing 2.0 × ATR, Style Auto
Summary, map and change levels from the 4H structure
Swing size 2.5 × ATR, to match a chart that uses it
Chart TF 1H; the table still shows 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W

plainWords: Plain words work too: "on 4H", "my swing size is 2.5", "Style Swing".

routes.note: When it reads a chart, the skill only reads. It never changes your symbol, timeframe, layout, inputs, scripts, alerts or drawings.

rows: Settings box and header
Quick mode, swing size, Style, chart timeframe, the last price and the time of the newest bar. A ⚠ appears when the data is more than 4 days old.
Structure snapshot
One tile per timeframe: Uptrend or Downtrend, the distance to the Protected level in ATR, and whether the timeframes agree.
Summary
The chart timeframe in four lines: structure since the last CHoCH, the leg and how much of it price has recovered, the Bottom-out areas, and the higher timeframe.
Structure map
The last 120 closed bars with swings, the Protected level, liquidity zones, Bottom-out areas, order blocks, the leg POC and Smart POC levels.
Structure by timeframe
Since CHoCH, BOS count, the last four swings (HH, HL, LH, LL), leg position and the last closed bar of each timeframe.
Recent events
BOS, CHoCH and sweeps across all timeframes, newest first.
What changes the structure
Per timeframe: the close that makes a CHoCH, the close that makes the next BOS, and the nearest liquidity. State, not trade levels.
Position in the down leg · Bottom-out
For every timeframe in a Downtrend: below Stable, inside Stable, inside Confirm or above Confirm ✓, with a candlestick chart.
Volume layers
Order blocks with their volume rank, the leg profile POC and value area, Smart POC levels, and the test evidence behind them.
Both sides
What supports the current structure and what would change it, equal in weight, then a learning note.
report.note: Volume layers are reference levels that describe where the leg traded, not turning points. The report quotes the test behind them (S50 1H, 2023–26): the first test of a Smart POC held for two sessions 49% of the time against 32% for random levels; order blocks held about as often as random zones; no POC acted as a magnet. Print the page to PDF from your browser if you need a file.

config:
chart_tf: 1D                     # timeframe the summary, map and change levels use
dashboard_tfs: [1H, 4H, 1D, 1W]  # structure table rows
bars: 300                        # per timeframe (quick mode)
swing_k: 2.0                     # indicator input "Swing size (× ATR)"
style: Auto                      # Auto | Scalp | Swing | Position
symbol_defaults:                 # skip the exchange question
  XAUUSD: OANDA:XAUUSD
  BTCUSD: BITSTAMP:BTCUSD
configText: config.yaml in the skill folder holds your defaults. Edit it before zipping, or simply say the setting in your request.

trouble.a: Check it is switched on in Customize → Skills and that code execution is on, then start a new chat.
Add the TradingView connector, or attach CSV exports for 1H, 4H, 1D and 1W.
Check the symbol and exchange, the swing size and Style, and whether the bar is still forming. The skill reads closed bars only.
The bars had no volume column. With the connector, volume comes with the bars; with CSV, keep the volume column in the export.
The newest bar is more than 4 days old. Run again so the skill fetches fresh bars.
Upload the zip as downloaded, and do not rename the folder inside it.

faq.q: Does it give buy or sell signals?
faq.a: No. It reads structure by principle. A built-in check blocks advice words before anything is shown, and every report ends with a disclaimer.

faq.q: Do I need the indicator on my chart?
faq.a: No. The skill computes the structure itself from price data. Add Auto Market Structure & Liquidity on TradingView to see it and compare.

faq.q: Is the TREND / READY / WAIT dashboard included?
faq.a: Not in this quick-mode version. The report covers structure, liquidity, Bottom-out and the volume layers; the 12-state dashboard stays on the chart.
Anything with OHLCV data: forex, metals, crypto, stocks, indices and futures.
The scripts run inside Claude's code environment and make no network calls. Price data comes only from the route you use.
